history: Acceptance test for the Qwen 4 kit (2026-11-11): the hand-run sci-distill arm Q35B replayed through a generated chain, with the same file (our Q8_0 conversion, sha256 f904644b...), build (67107ac34f build_sm60), flags and single P100, staged with the new disk path (engine.weights disk). Q35BK must match Q35B byte for byte (abstend.py compare); the pipeline adds --neutral-penalties, which the hand run did not send, so a mismatch is checked against the defaults audit first. Q35BKS exercises the sampled mode; Q35BS ran at -c 20480 in shards, so a match there is a bonus. Kept outside recipes/: qwen3.5-9b is a registry model.
